transcript.content:
A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: Let me compare per-service span behavior between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) p95_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code<>'Unset' AND attr_status_code<>'Ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2), sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code<>'Unset' AND attr_status_code<>'Ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,3,1

content.text: Frontend and search server spans are both much slower, with no error status codes. Next I'll break this down by span name and pod to find where the time goes.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, service_name, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, attr_span_kind k, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) p95 FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('frontend','search','reservation','rate','profile','geo','attractions','user','recommendation') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'a', service_name, span_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,1

content.text: The slowdown sits on the `search → rate.Rate/GetRates` client span (about 1.7 s), while the rate server span stays at about 0.6 ms. That points at the wire or at search's client side, not rate's processing. I'll check the network metrics and pod-level resource metrics to tell those apart.

content.text: No hubble per-connection metrics here, so I'll compare pod-level metrics for the services involved (search, rate, frontend, reservation, geo) against normal.

input.query: SELECT 'n' p, metric, service_name svc, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, round(avg(value),3) avgv, round(max(value),3) maxv, count(*) n FROM normal_metrics_sum WHERE metric IN ('k8s.pod.network.errors','k8s.pod.uptime','k8s.pod.network.io','container.cpu.time') AND service_name IN ('search','rate','frontend','reservation','geo','memcached-rate-1','mongodb-rate') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'a', metric, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, round(avg(value),3), round(max(value),3), count(*) FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE metric IN ('k8s.pod.network.errors','k8s.pod.uptime','k8s.pod.network.io','container.cpu.time') AND service_name IN ('search','rate','frontend','reservation','geo','memcached-rate-1','mongodb-rate') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,4,1

content.text: Pod restarts, uptime, and network error counters are all unchanged, and rate's network I/O is flat. Next I'll check logs for the affected services and see which frontend paths the slowness hits.

content.text: {"root_causes":[{"service":"search","fault_kind":"http_slow","evidence":[{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT s.service_name AS caller, c.service_name AS callee, c.span_name, count(*) AS n, round(avg(s.duration)/1e6,1) AS caller_span_ms, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,2) AS callee_span_ms FROM abnormal_traces s JOIN abnormal_traces c ON c.parent_span_id = s.span_id AND c.trace_id = s.trace_id WHERE s.service_name = 'search' AND c.service_name IN ('rate','geo') GROUP BY ALL","claim":"search's rate.Rate/GetRates calls average about 1.7 s while rate's own server spans average about 0.6 ms."},{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT service_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, count(*) AS n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) AS avg_ms FROM abnormal_traces WHERE span_name IN ('rate.Rate/GetRates','geo.Geo/Nearby') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3","claim":"Only search's rate client spans are slow; search's geo client spans stay around 0.5 ms in the abnormal period."},{"kind":"metric","sql":"SELECT service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, metric, round(avg(value),3) AS avg_v FROM abnormal_metrics_sum WHERE service_name IN ('search','rate') AND metric IN ('k8s.pod.network.errors','k8s.pod.uptime') GROUP BY ALL","claim":"Search and rate pods show zero network errors and steady uptime averages around 13,450 s, with no restart seen."}]}],"propagation":[{"from":"search","to":"frontend","evidence":[{"kind":"trace","sql":"SELECT s.service_name AS caller, c.service_name AS callee, c.span_name, count(*) AS n, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) AS child_ms, round(avg(s.duration)/1e6,1) AS parent_ms FROM abnormal_traces s JOIN abnormal_traces c ON c.parent_span_id = s.span_id AND c.trace_id = s.trace_id WHERE s.service_name = 'frontend' AND c.service_name = 'search' GROUP BY ALL","claim":"frontend's search.Search/Nearby client spans average about 1716 ms, inside frontend parent spans averaging about 1720 ms."}]}]}
